source.code:
/--
Non-strict inequality of word-sized unsigned integers, defined as inequality of the corresponding
natural numbers. Usually accessed via the `≤` operator.
-/
def USize.le (a b : USize) : Prop := a.toBitVec ≤ b.toBitVec
